products.title: Oreste Console Table - Travertine Look - Cream
products.body_html:
The Oreste Console Table features a stunning mixed material look that is convincingly brought to life with concrete. Plump rounded corners and an asymmetrically shaped table top evokes a relaxed charm while the concrete structure mimics the natural beauty of both travertine and wood. The result is a design that highlights the raw beauty and versatility of the material, making it a statement piece indoor or outdoors.


  • Glass fibre-reinforced concrete is incredibly durable and long-lasting.
  • Sealed with a topcoat for added protection against moisture and staining.
  • Faux wood effect on base is painted by hand and designed to resemble natural wood graining.
  • Faux travertine effect is created using a hand-applied water transfer finish and mimics the natural characteristics of marble.
  • Crafted from a natural concrete mix, each piece will look different.
  • Variations in colour, texture, imperfections, surface scratches and non-structural hairline cracks are inherent and valued qualities of concrete.
  • Apply protective covers or store inside when not in use and during extreme weather/seasons to prolong the life of outdoor items.
